items.headline: Matt Vezza's TD proves difference in Ohio's 13-10 win over Kent State
items.description: — Matt Vezza had a touchdown run, Will Hryszko made two field goals and Ohio won its Mid-American Conference opener with a 13-10 victory over Kent State on Saturday.

items.headline: DeShields accounts for 3 TDs, Kent State tops Ball State 26-13 in MAC opener
items.description: — Dru DeShields threw for two touchdowns and ran for another to lead Kent State to a 26-13 win over Kent State in the Mid-American Conference opener for both teams on Saturday.
